messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER • High - FinTrust dedicated pool - elevated log retention due to debug. Paging @sara-oncall and @mike-sre :rotating_light:

sara-oncall: got the page. restarting routing jobs now, will check logs. FinTrust in dedicated VPC, customers report request timeouts ~10:12 UTC.

mike-sre: I'm on the VPC console. I see repeated 500s from the auth frontends -> backend. Enabling extra request-level debug; turning on full logging for pool aurora-fintrust for 30m to capture trace.

jess-prod: heads up — FinTrust legal flagged strict retention. we need legal signoff before storing unredacted logs. cc @legal-ops.

alex-se: FinTrust (enterprise) asked for tenant-isolation-sensitive handling. we can stream to ephemeral S3 bucket with restricted ACL for debug, then purge. question: do we need to redact PII in-flight or can legal allow short retention?

legal-ops: Noted. We cannot authorize retention of logs containing PII beyond customer contract. For emergency debugging, Legal will consider a temporary exception if: 1) scope is strictly limited, 2) retention time is minimal (<= 4 hours), 3) access is auditable and limited to named engineers, and 4) customer approval or documented expectation. Need details on what fields are in the logs.

mike-sre: quick log snippet (masked):
```
[2026-06-14T10:12:48Z] request_id=aa1b user_id=REDACTED method=POST path=/v1/generate resp=500 err="kv_cache_oob" body_preview="{\"prompt\":\"Transfer $5000 to ...\"}"
```
We saw tokens that look like account numbers and first/last names in the body_preview.

alex-se: customer integration sends input text (user utterance) as part of logs for debugging; that contains PII.

cust-success: FinTrust rep (samantha@fintrust) already pinged support slack DM, asking for status and offering to sign any temporary debug waiver.

legal-ops: If FinTrust signs a debug waiver, that helps but we still need our internal mitigation controls. Propose: create ephemeral bucket in FinTrust's VPC (customer-owned storage) and run diagnostics there, or a redaction pass before storing in our S3. Which is faster?

kevin-eng: creating redaction pipeline will take 30-45 mins. Creating ephemeral bucket in customer's VPC and uploading logs there (with their KMS) is faster if they allow it. We can also stream logs with field-level masking for email/cc/ssn regex in ~12m.

sara-oncall: operational plan for next 60m: 1) Pause retention on central pool (done), 2) stream raw debug to ephemeral FinTrust bucket if they agree, 3) if they refuse, stream to our ephemeral bucket with immediate redaction pass. Need legal to approve 4h exception if raw retained.

jess-prod: also planning rollbacks: if kv_cache_oob persists after restart, we have a canary to revert to previous model variant for FinTrust only. That avoids further PII in logs from the failing path.

mike-sre: restarted routing jobs at 10:22 UTC — initial error rate down from 12% -> 4%. Still seeing spikes during long prompts. collecting a 30m trace window now.

cust-success: reaching out to FinTrust contact for bucket preference now. they said they'd rather us handle on our infra with redaction, unless legal insists on customer-owned storage.

legal-ops: temporary exception approved conditionally: up to 3 hours of raw debug retention in our ephemeral bucket, accessible only to named engineers (mike-sre, sara-oncall, kevin-eng), with audit logs shipped to Legal. Customer must sign an online waiver (I have a template). If customer refuses, we must enforce redaction before storage.

mike-sre: copying waiver link to FinTrust. grant access to only the 3 named engineers. starting upload to ephemeral bucket now — streaming first 2 minutes for inspection.

deploy-bot: Upload started: ephemeral-bucket://fintrust-debug/1791223345/ — 2 files (partial_trace_1.log, partial_trace_2.log).

alex-se: note: redaction regex failed on some locale formats (FinTrust uses IBAN-like strings). kevin-eng working on extended rules.

kevin-eng: deployed mask rules update. rerunning redaction on partial_trace_1.log — removing probable account numbers and emails.

mike-sre: Manual inspection shows a handful of lines with unredacted names in body_preview. I'm marking line numbers and will request legal review before we let anyone else access full logs.

legal-ops: Acknowledged. We will review. Please attach the sanitized sample and the exact access grant list. Also include retention auto-delete timestamp.

cust-success: FinTrust signed the waiver at 10:45 UTC and confirmed they prefer our ephemeral bucket with redaction first, but will permit raw for 1 hour if absolutely needed.

sara-oncall: updating incident timeline: 10:12 - error spike, 10:22 - restart, 10:30 - debug stream enabled, 10:45 - waiver signed. Keep handoff notes for next oncall.

jess-prod: rolling canary to previous model variant for FinTrust at 10:50 UTC to reduce error exposure. Monitoring latency/throughput.

mike-sre: error rate back to baseline (~0.5%) after canary. closing immediate customer impact — still keeping debug window open until 11:45 per legal.

legal-ops: set retention auto-delete for 11:45 UTC and audit-only access thereafter. We will log all accesses. Anyone who accesses beyond the three named engineers needs explicit Legal approval.

sara-oncall: will hand off to @jess-prod at end of shift. please capture the short post-incident list: redaction rules to add IBAN and currency patterns, improve preview scrubbing, formalize waiver workflow in runbook.

jess-prod: ack. taking over incident for postmortem. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • FinTrust dedicated pool • severity reduced to LOW • timeline will be added to postmortem channel.
